rows.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_map_mul_fiberPosterior
rows.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} (p : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ (PMF.map f p).support) (x : X),
  (PMF.map f p) y * (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskFiberPosterior p f y hy) x =
    if f x = y then p x else 0

rows.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_conditionedRow_mass
rows.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {Z : Type uZ} [inst : Fintype X] (p : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (K : X → PMF Z)
  (fallback : Y → PMF Z) (y : Y) (z : Z),
  (PMF.map f p) y * (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskConditionedRow p f K fallback y) z =
    ∑ x, if f x = y then p x * (K x) z else 0

rows.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_tv_bind_same_weights
rows.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Z : Type uZ} [Fintype X] [Fintype Z] [inst : MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z]
  (p : PMF X) (K L : X → PMF Z) (ε : ℝ),
  (∀ x ∈ p.support, UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (K x).toMeasure (L x).toMeasure ≤ ε) →
    UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (p.bind K).toMeasure (p.bind L).toMeasure ≤ ε

rows.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.risk_conditionedRow_tv_le
rows.type:
∀ {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {Z : Type uZ} [Fintype X] [Fintype Z] [inst : MeasurableSpace Z]
  [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] (p : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (K : X → PMF Z) (L : Y → PMF Z) (ε : ℝ),
  0 ≤ ε →
    (∀ (x : X), UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (K x).toMeasure (L (f x)).toMeasure ≤ ε) →
      ∀ (y : Y),
        UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist
            (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskConditionedRow p f K L y).toMeasure
            (L y).toMeasure ≤
          ε
